导入 JSON 数据集：documents、queries（id / text: Import JSON with documents and queries (id / text / relevant / rules). Up to 200 documents, 20 queries and six rules per query. Labels and edits require review. Files are sent only to this local server.

成功：Top-k 至少一个相关文档。优先级使用排名差异；不跨模型比较原始分数。接: Success means at least one relevant document in Top-k. Priority uses rank differences, not raw scores across models. Accept only if the rewrite preserves relevance labels. Review new reduced text separately. Regression tests should fail until the known issue is repaired.
搜索后展示基线分歧、扰动引发的单模型失败或共同回退。: Search reveals baseline disagreements, single-model failures and shared regressions.
从检索现象，到可复现证据。: From retrieval behavior to reproducible evidence.

Demo 是确定性的哈希词袋，用于体验流程，不代表真实语义模型表现。真实模型首次: Demo encoders are deterministic hashed lexical baselines, not semantic models. Real models download on first use.
失败：Top-k 中没有任何已标注相关文档。历史仅保存在当前浏览器。分数不跨模型: Failure: no labeled relevant document in Top-k. History is stored in this browser. Do not directly compare raw scores across models.
使用上方原始 Query、文档、修改前标签和两个模型。最多六条不重叠的替换规则，: Uses the original query, corpus, original labels and two models above. Up to six non-overlapping rules; each source occurs exactly once. Search only relevance-preserving combinations. Minimum means rule count within this finite space, not arbitrary text.
无法连接模型列表，请检查服务。: Cannot load models. Check the server.

展开排名表，检查标签和变体含义，填写依据后接受、拒绝或标记不确定。: Expand rankings, inspect labels and meaning, then write a rationale and accept, reject or mark uncertain.
接受模型分歧案例后缩减编辑；新的缩减文本需要重新审核。: Accept a disagreement before reducing edits. Review any new reduced text again.
将 ZIP 解压，在已安装项目的环境中运行 pytest test_regres: Extract the ZIP and run pytest test_regression.py in an environment with this project installed. Known failures should fail until repaired.
